currentCatalogEvidence.numberingSummary: 1-118, 120, 131, plus unnumbered Pikachu at the Museum

inventoryVariantRisk.reason: MEP has multiple physical printings sharing collector numbers, including Staff, Pokemon Center, prerelease/stamped, Cosmos Holo, Winner, World Championships and other event/product releases.
inventoryVariantRisk.rule: Do not infer inventory availability from schema variants or rarity. Build explicit per-card inventoryVariants from independently verified physical-printing evidence.
